purpose: 서로 다른 크기의 컵으로 잰 상황을 보여 주는 비교 맥락 그림

generation.prompt: Create a clean 2D educational game illustration for Korean elementary grade 3 mathematics, capacity comparison. Wide landscape composition, 2:1 aspect ratio. Show two matching transparent water containers side by side on a dark navy classroom-lab backdrop. On the left, place one clearly small paper cup beside the first container; on the right, place one clearly larger paper cup beside the second container. Make the cup-size difference immediately obvious, while the two water containers remain comparable in size and shape. Friendly polished mobile-game illustration, bright cyan water, crisp outlines, uncluttered composition, generous safe margins. No characters. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no labels, no badges, no UI panels, no buttons, no arrows. Do not imply which container has greater capacity; this image only shows that different-sized cups were used.

reviewNote: 생성 그림은 서로 다른 컵을 쓴 맥락만 보여 준다. 정답은 문제 문장, 구조화된 문항 데이터, 학생 선택으로 판정한다.
